source_title: Official $360 Espeon and Umbreon Pokemon Release Confirmed for November 6 - GameRant
source_excerpt:
A brand-new Pokemon release is officially releasing on November 6, featuring the beloved Eeveelutions Espeon and Umbreon, and costing a whopping $360. The 30th anniversary of the series in 2026 has featured many surprise and/or exclusive releases so far, such as the Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 ports of Pokemon FireRed and LeafGreen and the trailer for Pokemon Winds and Waves ahead of their 2027 debut. There are even more Pokemon products, games, and in-game events coming this year, with November and December having a lot of new releases to look forward to.
Currently, Pokemon Pokopia has a Halloween event where players can get several freebies, and Pokemon GO keeps on adding new critters over time alongside free and paid events. Another hyped Pokemon 30th anniversary release for December 2026 is coming out in Japan exclusively, and it comprises art books dedicated to the series' history, all generations of games, cut content, and developer interviews. Yet, one of the most beloved releases so far this year is the 30th Celebration set for Pokemon TCG , featuring great pulls and unique cards for fans to collect, now with a more expensive Eeveelution bundle.
Pokemon's Espeon and Umbreon Making a Comeback on November 6
A brand-new Pokemon TCG release called "Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration Ultra-Premium Collection—Day & Night" will be available worldwide starting November 6 with an MSRP of $360 for both bundles, or $180 each. The bundle includes 30th Celebration booster packs, several accessories, and exclusive Pikachu Ex and Espeon Ex cards for the Day version, or Pikachu Ex and Umbreon Ex cards for the Night version. On top of that, fans also get one 30th Celebration Classic Collection booster pack, including three cards from a selection of 30 cards. These include reprints of some of the most valuable Pokemon cards ever, such as 1st Edition Charizard and Shining Celebi.
Everything included in Pokemon TCG: 30th Celebration Ultra-Premium Collection—Day & Night :
1x Pikachu Ex card and 1x Espeon Ex card (Day bundle)
1x Pikachu Ex card and 1x Umbreon Ex card (Night bundle)
1x 30th Celebration Classic Collection booster pack
Espeon or Umbreon-themed accessories: Deck box Card sleeves Playmat Coin Dice
As shown by a recent Pokemon TCG Umbreon card sale breaking $1,000,000 at an auction, the Dark-type Eeveelution remains one of the most beloved Pokemon of all time, and this may be reflected in the Night bundle's availability. These are both likely to be scalped, unfortunately, as they contain physical accessories and unique promo cards not available otherwise, meaning that fans may need to pay more than the $180 MSRP per box. In fact, the boxes are already going for $400+ each on third-party websites, and that's before they're even released.
From the same collection of new products is a bundle with new Pokemon designs for Mew and Mewtwo , who not only get dedicated cards, but also exclusive figurines for players to collect. These bundles also come out on November 6, but they are going to be much cheaper than the Espeon and Umbreon collection.
Still, Eevee and its evolutions have left a massive mark on the franchise, and they are also getting a similar new product. Another Pokemon release features new Eeveelution designs , with figurines dedicated to each of these critters as well as Eevee itself.
